title: Book Store API
tagline: Async book store with Docker deployment
description: A book store API built with FastAPI, SQLModel (async), and PostgreSQL. Full book CRUD with author foreign-key validation, session-cookie auth, and a production-shaped Docker setup.
highlights: Async SQLAlchemy 2 + psycopg3 with greenlet-safe session management
HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax session cookies with 30-min TTL
Multi-stage Docker build with healthcheck and persistent volume
Ruff + basedpyright configured for linting and type checking
Domain-focused layout: each feature owns its models and routes
problem: A book store API needs full CRUD with referential integrity (books must have valid authors), secure auth, and a deployment path that does not require manual server setup.
constraints: Async end-to-end: async engine, async sessions, async endpoints
Passwords hashed with pwdlib's recommended hasher
Session cookies must be HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax
Docker image must be multi-stage and production-sized
architecture: app/book and app/user each own model.py and router.py
Two-stage Dockerfile: builder + runtime, with db healthcheck and volume
decisions: Chose async SQLAlchemy 2 over sync for I/O-bound API workloads
Used a shared response envelope so clients get a consistent {status, message, data} shape
Added render.yaml so the project deploys with one click, trading platform lock-in for speed
next: Pagination and filtering on book list
CI pipeline running ruff and basedpyright
